subject: [hw] DONE V02
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V02 PASS 796/796
(ASan+UBSan -O1: 381/381, plain -O2: 381/381, TSan: 34/34; about 7 s; builds only under /tmp/n2hw-v02.)

Independent checks against the same tree: T01 run_diff arm-O0/O2/O3v/armv8-O3v 0 mismatches (remaining arm stops are only the not-yet-present V17/V20; thumb stops are V16/V17-V20), V12 check_routing.sh 7/7, V10 check_routing_v10.sh 12/12, V14 suite 453/453.

What is done:
- n2a32_mem.c: 4 GiB PROT_NONE/MAP_NORESERVE reservation, thread-safe map/protect/bump-alloc (from 0x40000000, zeroed, never reused), MiB MMIO hooks + load/store (byte split across a MiB), destroy.
- n2a32_core.c: fetch/decode dispatch with the final masks (posted separately), A32 condition and T32 ITSTATE (advance after every in-block instruction, skipped ones included), PC from next_pc, stop reasons, icount/ilimit (exactly ilimit fetched instructions), stop_request, host-call page dispatch with interworking return to LR, N2A32_RETURN_ADDR, STOP_FAULT via per-run sigsetjmp for SIGSEGV/SIGBUS inside the reservation with chaining for everything else.
- n2a32_call: nested, AAPCS args in r0-r3 then the 8-aligned guest stack, caller-saved state/LR/flags/IT saved and restored, outer success leaves STOP_RETURN, nested success restores the caller stop, stack-write faults become STOP_FAULT.
- n2a32_hostcall_register/name: 4096 slots, mutex, slot 0 = unresolved, dedupe (fn,name), and fn==NULL accepted as a named unresolved slot for V03s loader.
- n2a32_excl.c: value-based __atomic_compare_exchange_n monitor, 8/16/32/64, per-cpu table, CLREX via excl_valid=0, two-CPU race test.
- n2a32_stub_classes.c: weak UNDEF classes + weak trace no-ops. build.mk: source list, flags, sanitizer presets (tested by including it from a Makefile).

Not done / not claimed:
- Not compiled for arm64 iOS (no SDK here), not run on the phone. Host x86-64 Linux + clang 23.1.4 only.
- No interpreter performance measurement.
- No unmap/free API (n2a32.h has none): allocations are never reused; the daemon must bound them.
- The fault handlers are installed once at first run and chain to the handlers that existed then; a later handler installed by someone else would take guest faults.
- The exclusive monitor table has 64 entries (beyond that the first is stolen); host-call names are mallocd and never freed (bounded at 4096 slots).
- T32 32-bit execution is only exercised through the test stub and the routing tests; V15/V16 implementations are separate packages.
- Only guest faults are tested; a host fault outside the reservation is chained but not exercised.

Files changed (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_core.c, n2a32_mem.c, n2a32_excl.c, n2a32_stub_classes.c, build.mk, test_v02/{run_tests.sh,gen.py,t_core.c,t_threads.c}. STATUS: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V02/STATUS.md (has the pasted output). I did not touch the phone, git history, or any other package.

Staying available for review findings; I will fix them and post DONE V02 rev N.
